meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: RBI bank groups, as on 31 March
meta.coverage: How many banks hold enough capital: banks counted by capital adequacy ratio band, all banks and by bank group, every March since 1996
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 329 (Distribution of Scheduled Commercial Banks by CRAR), number of banks, as published. The bands change over time (4/8/10 per cent to 1999; 4/9/10 to 2007; 9/10 per cent after), so each band is its own series. The count below the 9% minimum is derived for 2000 to 2007 by adding two published bands.
